pages.text: $(bold)Glacio — The Final Frontier$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:glacio difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:glacio death}}$()$(br2)A world in the Proxima Centauri system. Alien biomes, extreme cold, and the most dangerous creatures you will ever face. Glacio is harder than the End, harder than Oblivion's Rift. This is where the pack ends.

$(bold)Environmental Hazards$()$(br)• $(bold)Extreme cold$() — 2 HP damage every 5 seconds$(br)• $(bold)Mining fatigue$() from the alien environment$(br)• Alien mobs are fast, strong, and resistant$(br2)$(bold)Champion Density$()$(br)Glacio has the highest Champion spawn rate in the pack (25%). Champions here have a 60% chance of gaining custom affixes. Expect Commanding and Summoning champions frequently.

$(bold)Why Come Here?$()$(br)Glacio contains the exclusive materials needed to craft $(bold)MekaSuit Mk2$() — the ultimate armor set. Combined with Aethersteel and Primordial Essence from Oblivion's Rift, Glacio materials complete the most powerful gear in the game.$(br2)$(bold)Alien Ruins$()$(br)Crashed ships and technology caches hold loot found nowhere else. Possible dimension-specific affixes make Glacio gear truly unique.

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Glacio Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Alien Isotope$() (20%) — alien-tech integration$(br)• $(bold)Cryogenic Element$() (20%) — cryo-fusion technology$(br)• Ice Shards (30%)

$(bold)Void Adaptation Enchantment$()$(br)Glacio mobs have a $(bold)12% chance$() to drop an enchanted book of $(bold)Void Adaptation$() (max level 2). This armor enchantment:$(br)• Negates mining fatigue from alien environments$(br)• Provides immunity to alien debuffs$(br)• Even level 1 removes Glacio's mining fatigue$(br2)Combined with Thermal Regulation for cold immunity, these two enchantments make Glacio survivable.

$(bold)Preparation Checklist$()$(br)• MekaSuit (minimum)$(br)• Soulbound III on all gear$(br)• Thermal Regulation enchantment (level 3)$(br)• Void Adaptation enchantment$(br)• Full Vitality enchantment$(br)• Established RF infrastructure (Flux Networks recommended)$(br)• Emergency waystone or recall method$(br)• High-tier healing items$(br2)$(italic)Do not come here unprepared. Glacio will kill you.$()
